morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。所列音标为常见英语读法；实际读法以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 凯特琳：源自爱尔兰语的女性名字；在马来语文本中用作人名。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name of Irish origin, used as a personal name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Ireland.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Caitlin，首字母大写。不能仅凭名字推断国籍、族群或宗教。此项为专名说明，并非 DBP 普通词释义；以下搭配为自然用例，不代表经统计确认的高频搭配。英语读音及名称关系参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/caitlin)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Caitlin akan membentangkan hasil kajian dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Caitlin 将在明天的会议上汇报研究结果。
dual_scenarios.en: Caitlin will present the research findings at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Caitlin dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Caitlin sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Caitlin arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式。

messages.ms_spoken: Caitlin dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Caitlin sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.en: Has Caitlin arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tengah tunggu kita kat dalam. Jom!
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu kita di dalam. Marilah masuk!
messages.zh: 到了，她在里面等我们呢。走吧！
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting for us inside. Let's go!

etymology.historical_story: Caitlin is an anglicized spelling of Irish Caitlín, a name related to Catherine. Its familiar English pronunciation differs from traditional Irish pronunciations, illustrating how personal names change as they cross languages. In Malay writing, Caitlin remains a personal name rather than becoming an ordinary vocabulary item. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/caitlin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 常见英语读音近似“凯特琳”；把声音与具体人物联系起来，整体记忆，不拆成马来语词根。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式场合沿用本人使用的姓名、拼写和称谓；对方有 Dr. 等职衔时，按场合使用。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于介绍、点名和称呼。不要擅自改成昵称，也不要把名字解释为对本人性格或宗教身份的判断。
